pages.title: GlobeFlow ERP — Immersive Product Demo
pages.metaDescription: Apple-style immersive ERP product demo with scroll-driven storytelling and AI Agent workflow automation.

headings.text: Explain ERP like a product launch, not like a manual.
Every order starts a chain reaction.
A full ERP journey, compressed into one visual flow.
Ask the business. Not the database.
Built for demo first, upgradeable later.
Turn this into a real product launch page.

pages.visibleText: Skip to content GlobeFlow ERP Story Workflow AI Agent Deploy Install ERP PRODUCT STORYTELLING DEMO One ERP. Every workflow connected. A cinematic landing page concept for showing how Sales, Inventory, Delivery, Invoice, Finance, Reports, and AI Agent workflows move as one system. Experience the story View technical blueprint Revenue Flow $1.28M Orders 1,248 Stock Sync 99.8% SO DO INV AI Scroll 7 connected ERP stages 1 live operational source AI answers from real business context SCROLL-DRIVEN STORYTELLING Explain ERP like a product launch, not like a manual. Each screen focuses on one benefit. The visual stays cinematic while the message remains simple. 01 / SALES Every order starts a chain reaction. When Sales confirms an order, inventory reservations, delivery planning, credit checks, and reporting context can be prepared immediately. Sales Order SO-260617-0188 Approved Stock reserved Delivery queued Invoice ready 02 / INVENTORY Stock movements become business signals. Inventory is not just quantity. It becomes demand, margin, delivery risk, reorder timing, and management visibility. Live stock sync 03 / FINANCE From transaction to financial truth. Invoices, collections, cost allocation, GST, and audit trails stay connected so finance teams do not need to rebuild the story manually. Invoice $42,800 Tax 9% Payment Matched WORKFLOW AUTOMATION A full ERP journey, compressed into one visual flow. Sales Inventory Delivery Invoice Finance Report AI AGENT LAYER Ask the business. Not the database. The demo shows how an ERP AI Agent could explain operational status using controlled business context, permission-aware data, and traceable answers. Which customers need attention this week? 3 customers show delayed payment risk. 2 are linked to pending delivery, and 1 has repeated quotation drop-off. Credit Risk Medium Inventory Block 2 orders Next Action Call + review TECHNICAL BLUEPRINT Built for demo first, upgradeable later. Vanilla scroll engine No heavy framework. Scroll progress drives scene opacity, movement, and visual state. PWA baseline Manifest, service worker, install prompt hook, theme color, and offline-friendly shell. SVG-only icon system All icons are inline SVG paths, keeping the demo sharp without image dependencies. Reduced motion ready Users who prefer less motion still get a clean product story without heavy animation. NEXT BUILD DIRECTION Turn this into a real product launch page. Replace mock visuals with real ERP screenshots, add product video, connect content to a data file, then upgrade selected scenes with Canvas or Three.js only where it creates business value.
